scripts.clean:artifacts: rm -rf packages/circuit/account/target packages/circuit/storage/target packages/contracts/src/account_verifier.sol packages/contracts/src/storage_verifier.sol packages/frontend/public/account_circuit.json packages/frontend/public/storage_circuit.json packages/frontend/public/deployment.json packages/contracts/out packages/contracts/cache
scripts.circuits:info: cd packages/circuit/account && nargo info && cd ../storage && nargo info
scripts.circuit:account:prove: cd packages/circuit/account && export RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 && bb prove --slow_low_memory -b ./target/account_circuit.json -w ./target/witness.gz -t evm -k ./target/proof/vk -o ./target/proof
scripts.circuit:storage:prove: cd packages/circuit/storage && export RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 && bb prove --slow_low_memory -b ./target/storage_circuit.json -w ./target/witness.gz -t evm -k ./target/proof/vk -o ./target/proof
scripts.contracts:deploy: cd packages/backend && npx ts-node --esm src/fund_agent.ts && npm run deploy
scripts.full:circuit: npm run circuit:account:compile && npm run circuit:storage:compile && npm run circuit:toml && npm run circuit:account:witness && npm run circuit:storage:witness && npm run circuit:account:vk && npm run circuit:storage:vk && npm run circuit:account:prove && npm run circuit:storage:prove
scripts.full:deploy-verifier: npm run circuit:account:vk && npm run circuit:storage:vk && npm run circuit:account:verifier && npm run circuit:storage:verifier && npm run contracts:build
scripts.full:test: npm run agent:fund && npm run agent:test
scripts.full:pipeline: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run circuit:account:compile && npm run circuit:storage:compile && npm run circuit:account:vk && npm run circuit:storage:vk && npm run circuit:account:verifier && npm run circuit:storage:verifier && npm run contracts:build && npm run frontend:sync && npm run contracts:deploy && npm run front
